title: Code Artifacts

body.text: Code Artifacts are one of Claude's most powerful features. When Claude writes code, it shows in the Artifact pane with syntax highlighting — and even more exciting, Claude can
run HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in a sandbox instantly
, without leaving Claude.ai. You see the real result right away. For other languages, Claude shows
the expected output and explains how to run it

example: "Build an interactive to-do list with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — add/remove items, and save data in LocalStorage."

title: Iterating on code with Claude

body.text: One of the best workflows is iterating on code with Claude in a single conversation. Start by asking for the initial code, then report a bug you found or a feature to add, and Claude will
fix and update the code Artifact directly
, so you can see the change history. This style is great for
quickly building a prototype or MVP
— even non-developers can build small web apps.

example: "The code has a bug: when I click Delete, the list doesn't refresh. Please fix it, and add a Mark as Done feature too."
